QuestInfo.name: Pinjar Specialty
QuestInfo.0: Apparently, #b#p3006517##k has no intention of going to war. Listen to Eto.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p3006517##k and the warriors frequented the Coral Colony not for any nefarious purpose, but gather herbs that only grow there. With that in mind, Eto's asked you to help gather #bWater Drop Flowers#k from the #bGiant Coral Colony#k. Defeat the Specters there to find them.
QuestInfo.2: Per Eto's request, you brought the herbs.
